title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Claude Code 2.1.309: sandbox/permission hardening, MCP and hook fixes
bullets.summary: Latest release (22 Oct) fixes sandboxed Bash running shell startup files outside the sandbox, sandboxed commands modifying the --mcp-config file, a disabled MCP server being reconnected by a later permission prompt in print/SDK sessions, and a deny-rule bypass via Bash redirects; also adds a /claude-api Managed Agents subagent-team path and denies dangerous rm/rmdir at once in bypass mode on Desktop.
bullets.how: The Construct: upgrade Mac runners from 2.1.308 to 2.1.309 - the MCP-reconnect and --mcp-config fixes touch our scheduled claude -p runs directly. PRAGMA: concrete example of permission-layer hardening for client talks. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Claude auto mode becomes default for Pro/Max/Team sessions next week
bullets.summary: Per The Neuron digest, starting next week web, desktop and mobile sessions default to auto mode, where automated checks block risky actions; users can return to manual approvals (primary post on X).
bullets.how: The Construct: expect changed approval behaviour in interactive sessions; re-check our approval-gated routines and any prompts that assumed manual approvals. PRAGMA: talking point on classifier-gated autonomy. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: Anthropic donates Agent Skills to the Agentic AI Foundation (70+ platforms already adopted)
bullets.summary: Claude Developers say more than 70 agent platforms, including ChatGPT, Cursor, GitHub Copilot and VS Code, have integrated the Agent Skills standard since December 2025; MCP was previously donated to the same foundation (per The Neuron digest).
bullets.how: The Construct: our skills library is now a cross-vendor portable asset - keep SKILL.md files standards-clean so they work outside Claude. PRAGMA: sell skills as vendor-neutral client IP. Brand 9 Signs: no.

bullets.title: 1Password for Agents: credential access for autonomous agents, built with Anthropic and OpenAI
bullets.summary: 1Password announced a platform that gives autonomous agents access to credentials and services through its security system (per The Neuron digest; announcement video on X).
bullets.how: The Construct: candidate replacement for plaintext keys in runner configs and the .hermes folder. PRAGMA: client-facing answer to the agent-credentials question. Brand 9 Signs: maybe, for Signs365 and partner logins used by the order runner.

bullets.title: Ideogram vector model and Canva's first image model launch
bullets.summary: Ideogram released its first vector model that generates SVGs from text and converts images to vectors; Canva released its first image-generation model to all users (per The Neuron digest).
bullets.how: Brand 9 Signs: SVG output is directly relevant to the logo designer and logo-cleanup/vector-for-fabrication flow - test against our fabrication-check. The Construct: possible tool for the graphic-designer skill. PRAGMA: no.

praxis_lesson: Anthropic's cadence is now permission-layer fixes plus classifier-gated defaults, so pin and upgrade runners to the latest Claude Code each week and re-test approval-dependent routines before a default flips under you.
